body: Advisor: #2696 (BUG-2171/2170) is approved. #2692 is approved but CONFLICTING with main, and it conflicts with #2696 at the source level. Please (1) merge main into #2692's branch, resolving the conflicts, with no behavior change; push normally and mail REWORK READY with the sha. The advisor re-approves the merge commit and the operator clears the sensitive hold. (2) Once #2692 lands, merge main into #2696. Per the review comment: builder signature (prompt, mode, grant_env, ceiling_key, ceiling_value, contained); keep #2692's if-let revoke and drop #2696's; drop the redundant burndown PURPOSE scrub; run make check-ci-compile. (3) Then take BUG-2172 (HIGH): enforce containment at the spawn choke point for the nine uncovered launch sites. Details are in the spec.
subject: #2696 APPROVED; #2692 merge-up needed; next BUG-2172
